name: The Rooster
description: A brave, quick-footed rooster who will do anything to save his darling hen, running from one helper to the next to complete an impossible-sounding chain of trades.
visualPrompt: A colorful rooster with bright red comb and alert eyes, feathers slightly ruffled from running, standing upright with determined posture, fairytale woodland setting

name: The Hen
description: The rooster’s beloved companion, weakened after a piece of nutshell lodges in her throat, waiting in the hazelwood for help.
visualPrompt: A small warm-brown hen lying among hazelnut shells and leaves, wings partly spread as if recovering, gentle expression, soft storybook style

name: The Spring
description: A woodland spring that withholds water until it receives leaves, setting the urgent bargain-chain in motion.
visualPrompt: A clear forest spring bubbling from mossy stones beneath hazel branches, faintly magical presence suggested by glimmering water and lush greenery

name: The Baking Wife
description: A practical village baker who won’t give lefse without firewood, adding another link to the rooster’s quest.
visualPrompt: A kindly, sturdy village woman in simple traditional clothing, holding a flat round of lefse near a warm hearth, rustic kitchen details, fairytale illustration style

name: The Charcoal Burner
description: The one who finally takes pity, giving charcoal that unlocks the chain and makes the rescue possible.
visualPrompt: A soot-dusted charcoal burner in rough work clothes beside a small charcoal mound in the woods, offering a dark bundle of charcoal with a compassionate expression, storybook woodland atmosphere
